messages:
josh: deploy-bot flagged a canary failure for payments-gateway chart 2.3.1 in eu-west — 5xx spike at 10% canary, postupgrade hook OOM and secret mount failing: Secret 'payments-db-creds' not found. tagging @maria @sre-oncall. rollback or try stepwise fix?
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10%. Health check failed; snapshot logs attached. (bot)
maria: looking into logs now — the upgrade templates reference payments-db-creds, but our overlay in values/eu-west still references paymentsDbSecret. looks like a rename in the chart bump.
ben: we intentionally renamed the template var in 2.3.1 to kebab-case (payments-db-creds). supposed to be compatible, but overlay wasn't updated. my bad, the overlay PR didn't make it into the promotion.
carmen: quick options: 1) revert overlay to point at new name (fast PR + merge) and re-run canary; 2) rollback chart to 2.3.0 and pin promotion manifest; 3) hotpatch k8s resource to unblock (ugly). prefer option 1 if PR can land <30m.
josh: rollback path is straightforward with deploy-bot if we need it: `deploy-bot promote --chart payments-gateway:2.3.0 --force-rollback --region eu-west`. but we need to update release notes and pin the chart in the promotion manifest to avoid auto-retry.
maria: confirm no CRD changes in 2.3.1, so rollback to 2.3.0 safe. the core risk is overlay mismatch only.
ben: I'll open the revert PR to values/eu-west (restore previous key). will reference the chart rename in the PR body.
carmen: I'll stand by to re-run the canary immediately after merge. plan: merge overlay revert -> trigger canary 10% -> observe for 15m -> promote. if merge fails or CI fails, we rollback.
josh: note on release processes: if we rollback we'll need an explicit release-note entry and a pinned chart version in the release manifest so the promotion pipeline doesn't try 2.3.1 again. @release-bot can you prepare a rollback blurb to append?
release-bot: Added draft note: "Rollback payments-gateway to v2.3.0 for eu-west due to secretname mismatch in 2.3.1 canary. Action: update overlay and re-run canary or revert to 2.3.0 if fix not merged within 30m."
ben: PR opened: https://git.company/repos/platform/changes/pulls/1234 — title: revert eu-west secret key for payments-gateway overlay. cc @maria
carmen: saw PR, CI passing for overlay lint. I'm going to run a dry-run canary once merged: `deploy-bot promote --canary 10 --chart payments-gateway:2.3.1 --overlay pr/1234 --region eu-west --dry-run`
josh: okay. if dry-run passes and real canary looks healthy we'll proceed. otherwise we fallback to explicit rollback using deploy-bot command above.
maria: merged PR  — re-run promoted. starting canary in 2m. holding promotion window for eu-west for 45m to avoid accidental cross-region promotion.
deploy-bot: Canary re-run scheduled for payments-gateway:2.3.1 in eu-west (10% target). Streaming health events...
ben: watching logs — no postupgrade hook OOM, secrets mount present now. initial 5xx rate down to baseline.
carmen: keep watching for 10m steady state, then we can advance to 50% if healthy.
josh: who will update release notes if we fully roll forward? we should note the incident and the overlay gap.
maria: I'll update notes with timeline and mitigation. also unpin promotion manifest.
release-bot: Release notes updated with incident blurb and resolution steps.
ben: thanks all — good catch. let's keep the lesson: chart variable renames require overlay gating in the promotion checklist.
carmen: agree. we should add a pre-promotion lint that verifies values overlay keys against chart templates to catch this. filing follow-up: https://git.company/infra/issues/678
josh: action owners recap: ben — revert PR (done), carmen — run canary & watch, maria — hold promotion + update notes. ETA: 20m to stable.
maria: canary healthy at 10% for 12m, promoting to 50% now.
deploy-bot: Promotion progressed to 50%. No regressions observed.
maria: promotion completed to 100% for eu-west. unholding promotion window. release notes published. :tada:
